lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Seven distinct high-contrast white lines are visible; spacing is roughly uniform across the mid-section, with a wider gap between the second and third lines relative to the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line is a truncated segment limited to the upper-half of the torso; the third line from the anterior exhibits a break in continuity near the mid-lateral point.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of six distinct white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, concentrated above the hind limb joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge with a dorsal and posterior vector, curving laterally before converging medially in a lyrate spiral toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The inter-tip distance is approximately 2.2 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies the terminal 15% of the total vertical horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron on the nasal bridge; white spots on the maxillary/mandibular regions; white dorsal fringe along the spine; high-contrast orange/tan lower limbs.
